The '''Thalassian slavers''' were independent [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] hailing from the [[Thalassian system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], known to have hijacked [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to enslave everyone aboard. They also served as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] when [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] were low. As a result they were also known as the '''Thalassian Pirates'''.

Thalassian slavers [[Death/Legends|killed]] many [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvians]], selling their skins for its thermal properties to various industries. This almost led to the extinction of the species.<ref name="GG">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] including [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], [[Bufus Ritsomas]], [[Danry Ledwellow/Legends|Danry Ledwellow]], and [[Wuja Wojaine]] were implicated in a slavery ring by a Thalassian slaver during plea bargain sessions before trial. At this time, the [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild|Zygerrians]] and the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazaks]] were also operating slavery groups in the Outer Rim.<ref name="HN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_5.html|Senators Implicated in Slave Ring}}</ref> After the Clone Wars, Thalassian slavers joined forces with the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] in their fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Ciutric Offensive]].<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In times of the Empire, a cell of Thalassian slavers bought the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class freighter]] [[Twi'lek Dancer|''Venom Sting'']] from a [[Mining station/Legends|mining station]] after the death of the ship's previous owner, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Xufal D'uat]]. The Thalassians re-named the ship ''Twi'lek Dancer'' and discovered, to their pleasure, that it had been fitted by D'uat to be used as a prison. The Thalassians used this ship as picket defense craft and assault gunboat in their raids, and also customized its engines, shields and weapons. Eventually, the slaver cell was jumped by pirates, who requised the ship.<ref name="ss">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

With the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Thalassian slavers lost a lot of their former power, becoming a remnant of their former selves as slavery was outlawed by the new galactic government. Despite this, the Thalassian slavers continued to supply slaves to [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|crime families]] and other similar groups within criminal havens.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

By [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the slavers operated in small groups, each one with a [[Kaloth-style battlecruiser|''Kaloth''-class battlecruiser]] and several [[Y164 slave transport]]s along with starfighters and support craft.<ref name="SAV">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

One ''Kaloth''-class battlecruiser, named the ''[[Harmzuay]]'', would meet a rather violent end at the hands of [[Leonia Tavira|Admiral Tavira's]] flagship ''[[Invidious]]'' in a [[Battle of Algara|raid]] on the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] colony at [[Kerilt]].<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
